newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Wednesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well establlished, few early sales steady, not tested later as bid levels declined, USDA said.
Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs pt ld 67.50 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1175 lbs few early 68.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Wednesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady early, not tested late as bid levels declined.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs early 110.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
